source: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH) & Karnataka Traffic Police Blackspot Audit
description: Catalog of officially identified high-fatality and severe injury road accident blackspots in Bangalore metropolitan region.

accident_blackspots.name: Hosur Road - Kudlu Gate Junction
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: High vehicle speeds, mixed pedestrian crossing, heavy commercial traffic

accident_blackspots.name: Hosur Road - Bommanahalli Junction
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: Bottleneck entry to Silk Board, bus stop lane weaving

accident_blackspots.name: Outer Ring Road - Marathahalli Bridge
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: Weaving conflict between Old Airport Road and ORR fast lanes

accident_blackspots.name: Outer Ring Road - Bellandur Junction
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: Two-wheeler heavy pedestrian conflict, rapid lane switching

accident_blackspots.name: Tumkur Road - Goraguntepalya Junction
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: Heavy multi-axle freight trucks, elevated flyover blind merge

accident_blackspots.name: Old Madras Road - Tin Factory / KR Puram
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: High volume bottleneck, conflicting bus passenger movement

accident_blackspots.name: Mysore Road - Kengeri Bus Terminal
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: Intense suburban bus departures, high crossing pedestrian flow

accident_blackspots.name: Bellary Road - Hebbal Flyover Ingress
accident_blackspots.risk_factors: Airport corridor speeding, abrupt lane merges
